overview: A Sanatan Dharma companion app with 29 sacred pathways filled with real content — Gita library, daily duties, mantras, fasts, and spiritual practices.
features: Gita Library with all 18 chapters and 700 verses
Daily Panchaang on the home page
Aachar Saadhna daily duties and ritual explanations
Siddhi Saadhna with 8 Siddhis, 9 Nidhis, and Kalas
Guru Parampara with 4 Sampradayas and Diksha Vidhi
Vrat Saadhna with 18 fasts and 24 Ekadashis
Mantra and Mala practice with 108 mantras
